description:
WRITE (testnet) - buys or sells an Ammora-launched token on its GIWA Sepolia bonding curve (chain 91342). Exact input: a buy spends ETH (wrapped to WETH automatically), a sell spends tokens and returns WETH. Signed by the local GIWA key (Q402_GIWA_PRIVATE_KEY); gas is GIWA Sepolia faucet ETH, no real funds. 

REQUIRES CONFIRMATION - call FIRST with sandbox:false and no confirm to get a preview with a minAmountOut and a consentToken, show it to the user, then re-call with confirm:true, the same minAmountOut AND the consentToken. If the price has moved below minAmountOut by then, nothing is sent.

amount.description: Exact input amount: ETH for a buy, tokens for a sell.

confirm.description: Must be true for a real trade.

minAmountOut.description: Minimum output from the preview; pass back unchanged with the consentToken.

name: q402_token_trade
